courses.synopsis: Concept and principles of cottage industries. Case studies of the various types of cottage industries in Nigeria, their operations, problems and prospects. Government policies and laws on cottage industries in Nigeria. Review of cottage industries. (Particularly policies, laws, operations in selected other countries). Students registered for this course shall submit report of case studies/reviews done individually or group.
